title: A1 Swaara v1.0.1 - Instagram Reels Trending Audio & Viral Sounds Integration
changelog:
- Instagram Reels Trending Shelf: Discover top viral audio tracks directly from Instagram Reels on your Home screen
- Reels Audio Badges: Live view of viral reel counts (e.g. 12K reels) and trending indicator badges
- Reels Search Tab: Direct search chip in Search screen to find viral sound clips
- Full-Length Audio Bridge: Seamless bridge from 30-second Instagram sound bites to 320kbps full track streaming without cutoff
- Stability and playback optimizations across cloud sync and live jam rooms
